title.value: The load planning and sequencing problem for double-stack trains
title.justification: The title clearly specifies the focus of the paper, which is on the load planning and sequencing problem for double-stack trains. It encompasses both the planning and execution of loading sequences for efficiency.
title.quote: The load planning and sequencing problem for double-stack trains

extractions.description: This paper focuses on the integrated load planning and sequencing problem for double-stack trains at intermodal railway terminals. It aims to optimize the assignment of containers from storage to railcars and improve the loading sequence, reducing container handling by using integer linear programming formulations. The study shows significant efficiencies in operation with potential reductions in container handlings, specifically benefiting gantry cranes and reach stackers.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper addresses transportation efficiency in intermodal railway systems, which is a crucial component for reducing carbon emissions and improving logistics sustainability.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: A case study based on real data provided by the Canadian National Railway Company highlights that the LPSP can reduce the number of container handlings in intermodal terminals compared to sequential solutions by on average 11.3% and 16.5% for gantry cranes and reach stackers, respectively.

primary_category.justification: The paper contributes to reducing carbon emissions by enhancing the efficiency of freight transportation, a significant source of greenhouse gases.
primary_category.quote: Intermodal transportation plays an important role in global supply chains and is a growing market. In this context, load units are transported from origins to destinations using at least two different modes of transportation. When the long-haul leg of ground transportation is carried out by rail, the load units – usually in the form of standardized containers – must be transferred from one transportation mode to another.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper does not significantly cover other aspects of Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development outside transportation efficiency.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper specifically addresses enhancements in freight transportation planning and loading efficiency in rail transport systems, contributing to overall transportation sustainability.
primary_sub_category.quote: This paper addresses an operational planning problem which consists in selecting a set of containers to be loaded, assigning these containers to specific positions on double-stack railcars (so-called slots) and determining the order in which the containers are.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The paper does not delve into other sub-categories beyond improving transportation efficiency in rail systems.

applications.value: Optimization of freight transportation in intermodal railway terminals
applications.justification: The paper provides methodologies for optimizing load planning and sequencing for freight trains, directly impacting the efficiency and sustainability of rail transport in intermodal systems.
applications.quote: By extending prior work on load planning, we propose two different integer linear programming formulations. We show by an extensive numerical study that we are able to solve instances with up to 50 containers with a commercial general-purpose solver in less than 20 min.

new_primary_category.justification: The existing category of 'Climate Change Mitigation' and sub-category 'Transportation' accurately capture the paper's focus.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The existing sub-category 'Transportation' within 'Climate Change Mitigation' fully encompasses the paper's theme and contributions.
